outgoing.name: Australia
outgoing.excerpt: Sometimes grouped together as part of the United States Minor Outlying Islands, it is about one-half of the way from Hawaii to Australia.

outgoing.name: Cat
outgoing.excerpt: Feral cats were eradicated from the island in 1964.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: Its defense is the responsibility of the United States; though uninhabited, it is visited annually by the U.S.

outgoing.name: World War II
outgoing.excerpt: During World War II it was occupied by the U.S. military.
